Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
We played Jyhad^H^H^H^H^H VTES tonight for the first time since the DS
cards came in, and a very interesting situation came up regarding this
card. Fortunately, it was late in the game and didn't really matter at
that point, but it will probably come up again...

For this card (and all other Equipment cards which act as Unique
Locations, such as Dartmoor et al) - which cards affect them?

1. Can a Palatial Estate be taken away by a Disputed Territory?
2. Cam it be stolen with a Steal Equipment?
3. Is it affected by a Peace Treaty?

Basically, when someone else is doing something that affects this card,
is it treated as Equipment, Location, both or neither?

(Makes them really weak if _both_ can hose it, IMHO...)

Shane H.W. Travis | I try to take one day at a time,
tra...@duke.usask.ca | but sometimes several days attack at once.

Messages.Author: Greg Zuvich
Messages.Body:
In article <4a6692$6...@tribune.usask.ca>, tra...@duke.usask.ca (Shane Travis)
spammed:
#
#For this card (and all other Equipment cards which act as Unique
#Locations, such as Dartmoor et al) - which cards affect them?
#
#1. Can a Palatial Estate be taken away by a Disputed Territory?
#2. Cam it be stolen with a Steal Equipment?
#3. Is it affected by a Peace Treaty?

In answer to #2 and #3 my gut answer is NO, because of my answer to #1. Although
it is out into play as equipment I see it as a location *unique* to that vampire.
Consider that most unique locations, or any locations for that matter, are not
normally so specific, ie- they effect all your vampires or you as the Methuselah.
In this case, such cards are specific to *one* vampire. Since it does come into
play it does get the +1 stealth action bonus and requires the acting minion to
tap. But yet once it is in play it is treated as a unique location like it says
on the card. Imagine if you will, a vampire trying to stealth around trying to
take control of one specific location. This analysis seems to make sense to me.
Any other opinions? Tom?

--
Greg Zuvich |gzu...@symantec.com

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Shane Travis <tra...@duke.usask.ca> wrote:
>1. Can a Palatial Estate be taken away by a Disputed Territory?

Yes, since it's a location. My beliefs of exact interactoin:
Whoever gets control of it would choose any of their
minions (ready or in torpor) to put it on. If it is put on an ally, it
does nothing. If someone doesn't have any minions, then they can't be
chosen as the player to receive the location.

I'll check notes with the others, though.

>2. Cam it be stolen with a Steal Equipment?

It's also equipment, so can be affect by anything that affects
equipment.

>3. Is it affected by a Peace Treaty?

No, since it isn't a weapon.

>Basically, when someone else is doing something that affects this card,
>is it treated as Equipment, Location, both or neither?

Both.

>(Makes them really weak if _both_ can hose it, IMHO...)

I've brought this up a couple of times, and nobody seemed inclined to say
that they were locations *instead* of being equipment...



Messages.Author: frank scott
Messages.Body:
My opinion on this is that the game should maintain the distinction between
equiptment and location. Because the new "locations" have the equiptment
symbol and because the cards say treat them as equiptment(I think they do
at least) then you shouldn't be able to use Disputed Territory, but they could be stolen. As for the last question, I thought peace treaty only worked on
weapons.
